plain: Bob Lazar is a man who says he once worked on alien flying craft for the US government. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he describes what it felt like to be inside one of these craft: a real ominous, creepy feeling. He says much of it came from the black colour inside, which he says just did not look right.
